title: HireGen AI

listing.shortDescription: A generative-AI hiring platform that parses resumes, drafts job content and screens candidates — Next.js with Gemini, OpenAI and Hugging Face, on Neon PostgreSQL.
listing.fullDescription: HireGen AI is a full-stack hiring platform built around generative AI. The Next.js app signs users in, manages jobs and candidates, and layers AI across the workflow: resume parsing via PDF extraction, AI-generated job content and screening questions, and an analytics dashboard over the pipeline. Google Gemini, OpenAI and Hugging Face models sit behind a typed Next.js API with Neon PostgreSQL storage.

closing.conclusion: HireGen AI put generative AI directly into the hiring workflow — parsing resumes, drafting job content and screening candidates with a dashboard that shows the pipeline at a glance.
